verdict.rationale: Circle exposes building blocks that could support a payment-acceptance flow — Wallets APIs to create addresses (circle-docs-15, circle-docs-14), webhooks to confirm state changes/settlement (circle-docs-10), idempotency keys for safe retries (circle-docs-25), and Circle Payments Network / Gateway for moving USDC (circle-docs-11, circle-docs-31) — but there is no single documented 'checkout/payment API' product oriented at accepting a customer stablecoin payment (create payment → present address/flow → confirm settlement) as a packaged developer flow. missing for 10: a dedicated checkout/payment-creation API or SDK aimed at merchant payment acceptance, an explicit end-to-end code example combining address generation + settlement confirmation, and independent/hands-on corroboration of this specific workflow.
